dishes.name: Rehrücken Baden-Baden
dishes.desc: Saddle of venison roasted with a cranberry-filled pear, a game classic of Baden-Baden and the northern Black Forest.

dishes.name: Brägele
dishes.desc: Sliced boiled potatoes fried in a pan with onions and bacon until golden. The usual Baden side dish.

dishes.name: Kratzete
dishes.desc: Torn pancake fried until crisp, served with apple sauce or stewed fruit. A Black Forest and Ortenau country dish.

dishes.name: Striebele
dishes.desc: Fried lattice of yeast dough dusted with sugar. A fair and Fastnacht pastry of Baden and the Black Forest.
